This drop in calcium [कॅल्शियम] can lead to muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], paralysis, and other serious health [आरोग्य] issues if left untreated.Milk [दूध] fever [ताप] typically occurs within the first few days after calving [व्याने] when the demand for calcium [कॅल्शियम] for milk production [दूध उत्पादन] exceeds the cow [गाय]'s ability to mobilize calcium [कॅल्शियम] from its body reserves. Diagnosis [निदान]: Dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cows that are high-producing or in their third or later lactation are at higher risk for developing milk [दूध] fever [ताप]. Additionally, cows fed diets with imbalanced calcium [कॅल्शियम] and phosphorus [स्फुरद] ratios or those with inadequate vitamin D levels may be more susceptible. Diagnosis [निदान] of milk [दूध] fever [ताप] in cattle [गाय वर्ग] typically involves a combination of clinical signs, history-taking, and laboratory tests for measuring serum [सिरम] calcium [कॅल्शियम], phosphorus [स्फुरद] and electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] estimations. Blood [रक्त] tests to measure serum [सिरम] calcium [कॅल्शियम] levels are essential for confirming hypocalcemia. A definitive diagnosis [निदान] of milk [दूध] fever [ताप] is often based on low blood [रक्त] calcium [कॅल्शियम] levels (usually below a specific threshold) within the first few days after calving [व्याने]. In some cases, veterinarians may perform additional blood [रक्त] tests to assess other mineral levels (such as magnesium) and blood [रक्त] pH to evaluate the severity of the condition and rule out other potential metabolic disorders.Preventive measures, such as dietary adjustments, calcium [कॅल्शियम] supplementation, and close monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख] during the periparturient period, play a vital role in reducing the incidence and impact of milk [दूध] fever [ताप] in dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] herds. ``` ---- **General-SystMedicine** Source: पशुसंवर्धन व दुग्धव्यवसाय विभाग, महाराष्ट्र शासन ``` b) Urine [मूत्र] analysis: pH acidic/ lowered (5.0) Proteinuria. - c) Haematology High PCV (increased 50-60%) - d) Serum [सिरम] biochemistry: Increase in BUN due to renal failure. - Increased blood [रक्त] lactate. - Decreased bicarbonate. - Mild hypocalcaemia due to temporary malabsorption. results.question: When should deworming be done for newborn calves?
results.answer:
नवजात बछड्यांना कृमिनाशक (देवर्मिंग) जन्म घेतल्यानंतर पहिल्या आठवड्यात सुरू करा; नंतर सुरुवातीच्या ठहाह मासानांत दर महिन्याला द्या.

**वेळापत्रक:**
- पहिले देवर्मिंग: वासराच्या पहिल्या आठवड्यात लगेच एकदा द्या.
- पुढील पायरी: पहिल्या ठहाह महीने पूर्ण होईपर्यंत प्रत्येक महिना तपासून, तर त्यानुसार दर महिन्याला देवर्मिंग चालू ठेवा.
- १८ महिन्यांपर्यंतचे तरुण प्राणी लागोपाठ जास्त वारंवार करणे आवश्यक आहे — किमान वर्षभरात ४ वेळा हलवून करा.

**औषধ आणि मात्रा:**
- संदर्भातील शिफारशी: पक्षीपॅझीन अडेप्लेट किंवा अल्बेंडॅझोल यांची एकाच वेळी ग्राही मात्रा (उदा. १० ग्राम) वासरांच्या जन्मनंतर पहिल्या आठवड्यात नियंत्रणासाठी दिली असते; मात्र योग्य औषध निवड, डोस आणि अधिकारी पशुवैद्यकाचा सल्ला नेहमी घ्या.
- सतत एकच औषध टाळा; वेगवेगळी औषध फेऱ्यावर वापरा म्हणजे प्रतिकाराची शक्यता कमी होते.

**इतर काळजी:**
- तापमान, व्यवस्थापनानुसार थेट शेवटचे ठसाहे मासानंतर पुढे प्रति तिमाही (३ महिने) इतके गरज भासल्यास करणे सुचवले आहे.

मुशींच्या आर्द्र हवामानात दूध उत्पादनाची घट ही अनेकदा उष्णतेच्या ताणा व चारा खाल्ल्याचे प्रमाण कमी होण्याचा परिणाम असतो, म्हणून त्याचा शेताच्या भागावर लक्ष ठेवा.

**चारा आणि पोषण:**
- चायः मुलींना भरपूर स्वच्छ पिकाचा चारा (कोरडा/हिरवा) उपलब्ध करून द्या; फक्त गरजेभरा नाही तर चारा थांबू देऊ नका, कारण जास्त आर्द्रतेत पिकालींनी चारा जास्त वेगळी घेणे कमी होते .
- शारीरिक: श्रावानुसार संतुलित खाऊ मृत्यूला वाढू नये; यावेळी दिवसात सलग ४ महिन्यांत भोतरसंजी निर्देशांक घ्या .
- पौषित चारा: श्रावण साठी ऊर्जा (मंद दर), रक्तातील रक्तदाब नियंत्रण इत्यादीसाठी योग्य खायांची निवड करा; हे तपशील आपल्या स्थानिक पशुवैद्यकीय सेवाद्वारे नेमके मिळतात .

**खनिज पूरक:**
- सकटन: रोजच्या दिवसातील मासकितीमध्ये मिनिरेल मिरिजन यारू दूर करा, आणि जर झाले तर १५ ते २० ग्राम रेप्लंटा प्रत्येक मृत्तू दोनवेळा द्या .
- कैलीशियम व फॉस्फरस कमतरता झाली तर गरोदर अवस्थेत अशा क्षणी समस्या येऊ शकते, त्यामुळे पुरक दिल्यानंतर देखील दुर्मिळा समस्येसाठी वैद्य विचारणा करा .

**पाणी:**
- शातन: पिकासाठी पाण्याची गुणवत्ता आणि सुरेश पासून बदललेली जलप्रमाण हाही कारण असू शकतो, त्यामुळे पिण्याचे पाणी रात्री किंवा थंड वेळी दिल्यास चराचे आणि सुखाचे आहार वाढतो ;
- ढोकरी: छत्रकालीन मुकींनी पेटायला अधिक पाणी लागते, म्हणून साठवण व्यवस्था राबात ठेवा .

**तपासणी:**
- काय टप्पा आहे: व्यानी/दुधाचे सर्वाधिक टप्पा ६–८ आठवडे होता; यादरम्यान द्रव्यमान व चारा बदल असेल तर पिवळे केल्याने विश्वास ठेवं .
- स्थायी समस्या आहे का: बोंदरता, रंगविहीनता, स्टेन/केटोझिस/अॅसिडोसिस — याला कारण ठरल्यास धोरण वेगळे असेल, त्यामुळे तुम्हाला कुठलाई तरी या समस्या दिसत असेल तर सांगा .

श्रावण/आधार—उष्णता ताण असताना आहार/दक्षता तुम्ही कोणटी ठिकाणी/इतिहास सोदला? तुमचा मीळी गाव/तालुका/जिल्हा कोणट्या आहे? **स्रोत: राष्ट्रीय कृषी विस्तार व्यवस्थापन संस्था (MANAGE); वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (VNMAU)**

Camels are noted for their ability to maintain milk production [दूध उत्पादन] during drought [दुष्काळ] conditions due to unique physiological adaptations that support continued milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन] under prolonged inclement conditions. However, prolonged drought [दुष्काळ] can eventually lead to decreased milk production [दुधाचे उत्पादन कमी होणे] under thermal stress [तापमान ताण] conditions. Seasonal changes also significantly influence camel milk [दूध] composition, with variations in total solids [एकूण घनपदार्थ] and other milk [दूध] components linked to heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण], feed [खाद्य/चारा] quality, and water [पाणी] availability. Climate change impact [हवामान बदलाचा परिणाम] on livestock production [पशुधन उत्पादन]

The climate change [हवामान बदल] has great influence on the livestock [पशुधन] industries affecting production [उत्पादन], reproduction, animal health [पशु आरोग्य], input costs, product prices, and natural resources management [व्यवस्थापन]. The direct effect of climate change [हवामान बदल] on cattle [गाय वर्ग] is thermal stress [तापमान ताण] while the indirect effect being the low pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] availability and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता] and the increased incidence of pest [कीड] and diseases. Heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] and nutritional stress are the major factors that severely affect the reproductive performance of dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cattle [गाय वर्ग] under the changing climate [हवामान]. Increased ambient temperature [तापमान] leads to heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] and decline in fodder [चारा] and pasture [कुरण क्षेत्र] availability due to increased temperature [तापमान] and decreased rainfall have detrimental effect on reproduction in dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cattle [गाय वर्ग]. Effect of heat stress [उष्णतेचा ताण] includes reduced dry matter [सुका घटक] intake, increased water [पाणी] intake, Increase sweating and panting to maintain core body temperature [शरीराचा तापमान], Energy is shifted from milk production [दूध उत्पादन] to maintenance, increased mortality and morbidity, increased rectal temperature [तापमान] and respiratory rate.

Climate change [हवामान बदल] has the potential to impact the quantity and reliability of forage [चारा] production [उत्पादन], quality of forage [चारा], water [पाणी] demand for cultivation of forage crops [चारा पिके / चारापिक] as well as largescale rangeland vegetation patterns. The most visible effect of climate change [हवामान बदल] will be on the primary productivity of forage crops [चारा पिके / चारापिक] and rangelands. Most of the impacts of climate change [हवामान बदल] on livestock production [पशुधन उत्पादन] are mediated through non availability of feed [खाद्य/चारा] resources as well as affecting the quality of existing feed [खाद्य/चारा] resources. Grasslands cover about 70% of the world's agricultural area and they face a wide range of challenges from climate change [हवामान बदल] including the effects of elevated atmospheric carbon dioxide, higher temperatures, changes in precipitation regime and increasing concentrations of ground level ozone. These changes can adversely affect productivity, species [प्रजाती] composition and quality, with potential impacts not only on forage [चारा] production [उत्पादन] but also on other ecological roles of grasslands.

Total ration DM should be between 50 and 70%. Wetter or drier rations limit DM consumption. Miltch animals drink about 5 litres of water [पाणी] for each kg milk [दूध] (eg. a cow [गाय] producing 40 litres of milk [दूध] will consume 200 litres of water [पाणी]). Selection of healthy doe [मादी शेळी] and buck [शेळीचा नर] for breeding [प्रजनन]

Before purchasing, udder [कास] of female should be properly inspected for presence of any kind of defects. Females should only be mated after they have reached 70% of their adult body weight [शरीराचे वजन]. When does are bred too early, they produce more weaklings, which lead to a greater rate of kids loss. Both males and females should have an ideal body weight [शरीराचे वजन] corresponding to their age and breed [जाती]. Choosing males and females born as twins or triplets from a line of prolific parents leads to a significant improvement in the flock's kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे] percentage.

Vaccination [लसीकरण] of goats

All the goats should be vaccinated against major diseases of kids i.e. Enterotoxaemia, Tetanus [टेटॅनस] and Colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस]. Enterotoxaemia tends to be more deadly in young kids, and often in those which are the heaviest or fastest gaining and it is caused by the bacteria [जीवाणू] Clostridium perfringens types C and D. Tetanus [टेटॅनस] is a neurological disease [रोग] caused by a toxin which is produced by the bacterium Clostridium tetani. Clostridial organism is very common in soil [माती] and in the manure [खत] of animals. Bacterial spores enter the body through wounds caused by castration, ear tagging, disbudding [अनावश्यक कळ्या काढणे], kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे] etc, and symptoms [लक्षणे] occur 421 days later. Colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस] is one of the most common diseases of young kids with a high death rate. In neonatal coliform diarrhoea [अतिसार], enteropathogenic strains of Escherichia coli colonize the small intestine and produce an enterotoxin that causes diarrhoea [अतिसार]. Breeding [प्रजनन] females for enterotoxaemia and tetanus [टेटॅनस] should be vaccinated 46 weeks before kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे]. Pregnant goats for colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस] are vaccinated with two doses of vaccine subcutaneously 4050 and 1520 days before parturition against the natural form of enteric colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस]. By vaccinating does in late pregnancy [गरोदरपणा], some immunity [रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती] may be passed on to the kids through the colostrum.
```

**Dhaincha [ढैंचा] (Sesbania)**

Dhaincha [ढैंचा] is a leguminous dicotyledonous crop [पीक] and it grows rapidly. There are nodules on its roots, stems, and branches and they work to fix nitrogen [नत्र] from the air. This crop [पीक] can be grown in various types of soil [माती] compared to Boroo. In organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती], nutrient management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन] has to be done as per the needs of the crops. At the same time, it is possible to use biodynamic, Jeevamrut [जीवामृत], Beejamrut [बीजामृत], Panchagavya [पंचगव्य] etc. in organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. In addition to this, organic crop protection [सेंद्रिय पीक संरक्षण] recommendations have to be used to control [नियंत्रण] diseases and pests.

**Beejamrut [बीजामृत] (Seed Treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया]):** Beejamrut [बीजामृत] can be used for seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया]. To prepare Beejamrut [बीजामृत], mix 1 kg of native cow dung [शेण], 1 liter of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], 100 ml of milk [दूध], 50 gm of lime [चुना], 50 gm of loamy soil [माती] and 100 gm of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] viride and soak this mixture overnight and can be used for seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] on the second day.

**Jeevamrut [जीवामृत]:** Mix 10 kg of cow [गाय] or bull dung [शेण], 10 liters of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], 2 kg of jaggery [गूळ], 2 kg of gram flour [हरभरा पीठ], 1 kg of forest soil [माती] in a plastic drum in 200 liters of water [पाणी] and stir the mixture 3 times a day for 5-7 days. This mixture can be given to the crop [पीक] in 1 acre area through water [पाणी].

**Amrut Pani:** Mix 10 kg of cow dung [शेण], 250 gm of cow [गाय] ghee [तूप] and 500 gm of jaggery [गूळ] in 200 liters of water [पाणी] and give this prepared Amrut Pani to 1 acre area through water [पाणी] at an interval of 30 days.

1.6 Conventional Farming [पारंपरिक शेती] v/s Organic Farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] v/s Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

Both natural and organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] represent sustainable agricultural models, but they differ significantly. Organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] allows the use of certain organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते] and bio-pesticides [जैविक कीटकनाशके] produced outside, whereas natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] completely avoids external inputs, relying instead on natural biological products. By emphasizing self-sustaining ecosystems, natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] eliminates the dependency on external fertilizers and pesticides, making it a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative to conventional and organic farming practices [सेंद्रिय शेती पद्धती]. The differences between conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती], organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती] and natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] are given in Table 1.1.

results.question: जमिनीच्या आरोग्यासाठी निंबोळी पेंडीचा वापर कसा करावा?
results.answer:
जमिनीच्या आरोग्यासाठी निंबोळी पेंडी (कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ) हा सेंद्रीय खत म्हणून वापरता येतो आणि त्यामुळे जमीन सुपीक राहते.

**खत म्हणून मात्रा:**  
- कोरडवाहू/पावन शेती: ५ टन प्रति हेक्टर नवीन लागवडपूर्वी किंवा जुलै–मे महिन्यांत विभागून  
- बागायत शेती: १० टन प्रति हेक्टर लाखापुर्व वेळी/किंवा दोन हंगामांत विभागून  

**मातीमध्ये मिश्रणे:**  
- माती ओली असताना, एकत्र कुजलेला गोठा/सेंद्रिय कंपोस्ट + कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ एकाचवेळी करून घाला; याने मातीतील चांगल्या बुरशींचे प्रमाण वाढत असल्याची शिफारस आहे  
- विशिष्ट पीक शास्त्रीय उदाहरणावरून, हेक्टरी नेमकी **२० क्विंटल कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ** दुहेरी वाटून (जून व डिसेंबर) द्या, हा दर मला उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजात स्पष्ट सापडला  
- काही मार्गदर्शक सूचनांनुसार, **प्रत्येक चौरस मीटरसाठी ०.५ कि.ग्रा.** असा दरही दाखवला आहे; तो तेथील पीक/स्थितीनुसार लागू होऊ शकतो  

**उपयोगाचे फायदे (शिफारसीतील मुद्दे):**  
- संभाव्य रिकाम्या स्थानावरून तज्ञ स्रोत्यांनी नोंद केलेल्या मार्गदर्शक सूचनांनुसार, नियमित वापराने मातीचे आरोग्य अनुकूल ठेवण्यास मदत होते  

या पैकी योग्य मात्रा तुम्हाला तुमच्या प्रदेशाबरोबर व भागात सर्वमान्य पाठबळाव्शासह यादी देण्याकरिता माझ्याकडे फक्त वरील दस्तऐवजांचे अपूर्ण/अस्पष्ट डेटा आहे—यासाठी अधिक खात्रीशीर व्यवहार्य निर्णयासाठी तुमचं गाव सांगा? तुमचा गाव कोणत्या तालुका व जिल्ह्यात आहेत?

**स्रोत: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (MPKV), राहुरी; वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (VNMAU); इतर उपलब्ध मार्गदर्शक सूचनांची त्वरित उपलब्ध माहिती**

results.question: भातातील Gall Midge कसा ओळखावा आणि त्याचे नियंत्रण कसे करावे?
results.answer:
भातात गादमाशी ओळखण्यासाठी सर्वात महत्त्वाची जागडाचं लक्षण असते — अंकुराच्या बुंध्यात पांढऱ्या-पिवळसर "कांडा"सारखा पोंगा तयार होतो, पान गुंडाळून कांद्यासारखी वाटते आणि संक्रमित रोपांचा वाढ मंदावतो, ते फांद्या देत नाहीत.

**लक्षणे:**
- गादमाशी माशी玫瑰 रंगाची व दिसायला तुडतुड्यासारखी; अळी पोणात (अंकुरालगत) चिलंबटी ठिकठिकाणी बसून अंकुर खाईपर्यंत वाढ करते.
- अंकुराआसपास भाग निरनिराळा उभरा करून कांडा/पोंग तयार होतो, जो किमान ५% हिरव्या फुटांच्या ऐवजी चांदीज्या पोया म्हणले जाते.

**प्रतिबंध (कमी करण्यासाठी उपाय):**
- प्रतिकारक वाण लावा: सिंदेवाही-२००१, सकोली-८, पी.के. वि. गणेश; कोकणाकरिता विक्रा姆 आणि ढळिगूना वाण सुद्धा सूचित आहेत.
- गादमाशी लागण होणाऱ्या ठिकाणी शिफारसीत दिवसांपेक्षा १५ दिवस आधी लागवी करा.
- शेताच्या परिसरातील तण व खोड धान्य नष्ट करा.
- चिखलण्यावेळी गरडी पाने १.५ टन प्रति हेक्टर टाका; पुन्हा पाणी सोडून दिल्यावर ४ दिवस निकारमधलं पाणी बाहेर घेऊ नका.

**जैविक नियंत्रण:**
- उपलब्ध दस्तऐवजांतून गादमाशीच्या विशेष जैविक नियंत्रणाचा उल्लेख मिळाला नाही.

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण:**
- गोळी (ग्रॅन्युलर) कार्बोफ्युरान ३% @ २५ किग्रामकिंवा क्विनॉल्‍फ़ॉस ५% @ ५ किग्राम प्रति हेटर; रोपवाटिकेत ५% चांदीज्या पोया आल्यावर, तसेच लागवडीनंतर १० व ३० दिवसांनी सराव करा.
- कीटकनाशकाच्या फवारणीसाठी लिम्ब्डा सायहॅलोथ्रिन २.५% द्रव ५०० मिलियाँकिंवा प्रेफोनिल ५% द्रव १००० मिलियाँकिंवा थायमेथॉक्सॅम २५% डब्ल्यू.एस. ५०० ग्राम प्रति ५०० ली./प्रती हेटर सूचित आहे.

**काढणीनंतर:**
- संक्रमित (पोगायुक्त) रोपे उपडून जाळा; परिसरातील जंगлі भात व इतर तृणधान्य तण हंगामबाहेरील वेळेत तोडून टाका.

Ganesh. 2) In gall midge [गादमाशी] prone areas, transplant (between 2 to 20 July) 15 days earlier than the recommended date to reduce the incidence of gall midge [गादमाशी] on rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ]. 3) Put Garadi leaves at 1.50 tons per hectare in the field [शेत] at the time of puddling [चिखलणी], this also reduces the incidence of leafhoppers [तुडतुडे] and stem borers. 4) Destroy the surrounding auxiliary vegetation (Deodhan). 5) Remove and destroy pest [कीड] infested seedlings. 6) In gall midge [गादमाशी] prone areas, apply granular Carbofuran [कार्बोफ्युरान] 3% @ 25 kg or granular Quinolphos 5% @ 5 kg per hectare in the ridges at 7 to 10 cm (2 to 3 inches) water [पाणी] as soon as 5% silver shoot is found in the nursery [रोपवाटिका] 10 and 30 days after transplanting [पुनर्लागवड], whereas granular Carbofuran [कार्बोफ्युरान] 3% @ 25 kg or granular Quinolphos 5% @ 5 kg per hectare in the ridges at 7 to 10 cm (2 to 3 inches) water [पाणी] as soon as 5% silver shoot is found in the nursery [रोपवाटिका]. 5.5 Curative Methods

This section outlines strategies to conserve natural pest [कीड] enemies by minimizing pesticide [कीटकनाशक] use, diversifying crops, and creating supportive habitats like hedges, beetle banks, and flower strips to attract beneficial organisms. Some methods to biologically control [नियंत्रण] natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू] of pests are as follows:

- Minimise Natural Pesticides [नैसर्गिक कीटकनाशके]: Reduce the use of natural pesticides [नैसर्गिक कीटकनाशके] to avoid harming beneficial organisms that prey on pests.
- Allow Some Pests: Permit certain pests to remain in the field [शेत] as they serve as food or hosts for natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू].
- Diverse Cropping Systems: Implement mixed cropping [मिश्र पीक / मिश्र पीक पद्धती] systems to create a more diverse ecosystem that supports beneficial insect [उपयुक्त कीटक] life and reduces pest [कीड] pressure.
- Host Plants for Natural Enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू]: Include plants that provide food or shelter [आश्रयस्थान] for natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू], such as flowers that beneficial insects feed [खाद्य/चारा] on.
- Enhance Floral Diversity: Increase floral diversity within and along the boundaries of crop [पीक] fields to support a broader range of beneficial organisms. There are many possibilitiesto enhance floral diversity within and along the boundaries of crop [पीक] fields.

For habitat enhancement of the natural pest [कीड] predators, the following techniques are employed-

- Hedges Use indigenous shrubs known to attract pest [कीड] predators and parasitoids by offering nectar, pollen [पराग], alternative hosts and/ or prey. Most flowering shrub species [प्रजाती] have this property. However, care should be taken not to use plant [रोप/वनस्पती] species [प्रजाती] that are alternative hosts of pests or diseases.
- Beetle banks Strips of grass in the neighbourhood of crop [पीक] fields harbour different natural pest [कीड] enemy groups like carabids, staphylinid beetles and spiders. To lower the risk of weeds [तण] and plants known as host plants of crop [पीक] pests and diseases, one to three native grass species [प्रजाती] can be sown in strips of 1 to 3 m.
- Flower strips Three to five native flowering plant [रोप/वनस्पती] species [प्रजाती] can be sown in wellprepared seed [बियाणे] beds, arranged in strips of 1 to 3 m on the boundary of the crop [पीक] field [शेत]. After flowering, seeds can be collected to renew the strip or create new ones.
